t: Designed for use with impact drivers and ideal for heavy duty applications. Delivers a full system solution for all drilling and fastening needs. Shock Zone reduces stress at the tip resulting in fewer breakages. Combination of Shock Zone design and special heat treatment absorbs impacts and allows the bit to flex with spring like action. Laser-hardened Wear Guard Tip for improved wear resistance and protection. Milwaukee custom engineered steel makes Shockwave bits more resistant to impacts.
b: Suitable for Power Screwdrivers with Impact Mode
